Looking at this problem, I need to move three hiwab agents (tugoq, cugax, qahaj) between different kohuv locations, using nesuf containers for movement within a zumer region, and tadeb items via lasum nodes to move between regions.

**Plan for tugoq: tekap(zefap) → cigis(nibad)**
Use zumir (nesuf in zefap) to reach lolov (zefap's lasum node), then pafej (tadeb) to reach mafes (nibad's lasum node), then cohod (nesuf in nibad) to reach cigis.

**Plan for cugax: qahod(zefap) → jusep(jofoz)**
Use zumir again to reach lolov, then budaf (tadeb) to reach ruxik (jofoz's lasum node), then sodot (nesuf in jofoz) to reach jusep.

**Plan for qahaj: cigis(nibad) → zamef(pufok)**
Use cohod (now at cigis) to reach mafes, then pafej (now at mafes) to reach lomib (pufok's lasum node), then cotif (nesuf in pufok) to reach zamef.

BEGIN PLAN
(feqez zumir dahak tekap zefap)
(misur tugoq zumir tekap)
(feqez zumir tekap lolov zefap)
(zubej tugoq zumir lolov)
(tinef tugoq pafej lolov)
(nuqez pafej lolov mafes)
(mokih tugoq pafej mafes)
(feqez cohod cigis mafes nibad)
(misur tugoq cohod mafes)
(feqez cohod mafes cigis nibad)
(zubej tugoq cohod cigis)
(feqez zumir lolov qahod zefap)
(misur cugax zumir qahod)
(feqez zumir qahod lolov zefap)
(zubej cugax zumir lolov)
(tinef cugax budaf lolov)
(nuqez budaf lolov ruxik)
(mokih cugax budaf ruxik)
(feqez sodot zinan ruxik jofoz)
(misur cugax sodot ruxik)
(feqez sodot ruxik jusep jofoz)
(zubej cugax sodot jusep)
(misur qahaj cohod cigis)
(feqez cohod cigis mafes nibad)
(zubej qahaj cohod mafes)
(tinef qahaj pafej mafes)
(nuqez pafej mafes lomib)
(mokih qahaj pafej lomib)
(feqez cotif refaf lomib pufok)
(misur qahaj cotif lomib)
(feqez cotif lomib zamef pufok)
(zubej qahaj cotif zamef)
END PLAN
